scripts.android:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo run:android --variant release
scripts.config:dev: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=development expo config --type public
scripts.config:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo config --type public
scripts.export:dev: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=development expo export --platform android --output-dir dist/development
scripts.export:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo export --platform android --output-dir dist/production
scripts.check: npm run catalog:test && npm run typecheck && npm run config:check && npm run export:dev && npm run export:prod
